metadata.description: Semantic code search and architecture understanding for LingoLinq-AAC

Development PostgreSQL access, scoped to this repo only. MUST use LINGOLINQ_MCP_READONLY_DATABASE_URL, provisioned by scripts/provision-postgres-dev-readonly.sh, so postgres-dev authenticates as a dedicated SELECT-only Postgres role. The MCP package still wraps queries in BEGIN TRANSACTION READ ONLY + ROLLBACK as defense-in-depth, but DB grants are the actual security boundary. Also NOTE: this npm package is marked deprecated/no-longer-supported upstream; treat as a candidate for replacement, not a long-term dependency. Before approving on first load, self-verify YOUR OWN local `lingolinq-development` DB holds no real student/patient rows. Scot confirmed his was synthetic-only on 2026-06-14, but that confirmation is per-machine and does not carry over to any other checkout or clone. If your local DB is ever seeded from prod, do not approve it.
